checkEngineGpuUnused: {{backend}} ni a CPU- gusa Build, kugirango {{gpus}} izaba idakora. Hitamo a GPU backend mu Igenamiterere kugirango uyikoresha.

checkSearchInvalidVector: Imiterere y'ububiko bw'amaderese yahinduye igisubizo kitakoreshwa, ku buryo gushakisha dosiye bishobora kutagaruka na kimwe

welcomeTitle: Novera ikeneye gushyirwaho kuri porogaramu yawe
welcomeBody: Bifata iminota mike: Novera yinjiza mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga ikoranabuhanga ryayo ry'ingaruka n'umuyoboro muto wo gushakisha. Ushobora gukomeza gukoresha mudasobwa yawe mu gihe ikora.
setupDoneBody: Novera izakoresha imibare y'ubwoko bw'ikoranabuhanga ry'ubwoko bwa llama.cpp.
dsparkDescription: Iyimura i DSpark Q8_0 mugenzi ({{size}}) kugirango LFM2.5-2.6B. Ishobora kwihutisha igenerwa, ariko ikoresha RAM cyangwa VRAM birenzeho, isiga ububiko bw'amaderese bukeya kugirango ikibazo. Igerageza kuri porogaramu yawe; shyiraho uburebure bw'ikibazo cyangwa ugahagarika decoding mu igenamiterere rya model.
